skills.skill_desc: Each time Cyclops hits an enemy with his skills, all his skill cooldowns are reduced by 0.5s.
Cyclops casts two Stardust Disks in the target direction, each dealing 240<font color="62f8fe"> (+60% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> to enemies in its path.

Cyclops conjures <font color="a6aafb">Starlit Spheres</font> around himself, gaining 50% Movement Speed that decays over 2s.

The <font color="a6aafb">Starlit Spheres</font> automatically seek and attack nearby enemies (prioritizing enemy heroes), and explode on contact to deal 200<font color="62f8fe"> (+65% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font>.
Subsequent hits on the same target deal reduced damage.

Cyclops creates a <font color="a6aafb">Planetary Sphere</font> that tracks the target enemy hero or creep, dealing 500<font color="62f8fe"> (+120% Total Magic Power)</font> <font color="7f62fe">Magic Damage</font> and immobilizing them for 0.75-1.5s (scales with <font color="a6aafb">Planetary Sphere</font>'s travel distance).
